interface.shortDescription: Math practice, one hint at a time.
interface.longDescription: Sixteen original exercises across algebra, geometry, number theory and combinatorics, with worked solutions and progressive hints. Search techniques, plan a session, track progress locally and import your own exercises. Short answers use conservative text comparison, not symbolic equivalence or proof verification. Includes derivation-based review and reproducible checks; no claim of independent human or formal verification. Fully offline; not an official IMO collection.
